answer.policy_title: Molina Clinical Policy: Shoulder Arthroscopy (Policy No. 404) — publicly available umbrella policy
answer.effective_date: 2021-06-09 (original effective date shown in a Molina version of the policy); no later revision date was publicly verified
criteria_quotes: Please see MCG criteria for rotator cuff repair.
The denial notice states that the records did not document "an adequate trial of conservative treatment prior to the requested surgery."
answer.appeal_deadline: 2027-02-05, as stated in the denial notice. Molina Mississippi Marketplace materials also state that an internal review of an adverse determination may be requested within 180 days from receipt of the adverse determination.

submission_route.phone: (866) 472-9484, Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. Central Time
submission_route.mail: Attn: Grievance Coordinator, 1020 Highland Colony Parkway, Suite 602, Ridgeland, MS 39157
submission_route.instructions: For a written appeal, include the denial reference number, member information, the requested service and CPT code, and all supporting clinical records or other information to be considered. Molina's Mississippi Marketplace page identifies these telephone, mail, and fax routes for grievances and internal reviews involving adverse determinations.

answer.how_to_obtain_criteria: The publicly available Molina Policy No. 404 does not state the rotator-cuff-repair medical-necessity criteria; it directs readers to MCG criteria. Request from Molina, in writing and with reference number POC-AA9EA32E7D-95281, the complete MCG criteria or other clinical-review criteria actually applied to CPT 29827, including the version and effective date. The request may be sent with the appeal to the mailing or fax address above. Ask Molina and the treating provider's utilization-management department for the criteria used in the adverse determination.
answer.notes: A public Molina document titled "Shoulder Arthroscopy" and numbered 404 was located, but its rotator-cuff-repair section is not publicly available in the retrieved text and expressly refers to proprietary MCG criteria. Therefore, the specific publicly available document containing the governing medical-necessity criteria for CPT 29827 could not be verified. The public Molina Mississippi Marketplace page supports the 180-day internal-review period and the submission routes listed above.

transcript.content: You are helping a patient respond to a health insurance denial. Answer precisely and only from evidence you actually retrieve. If you cannot find the governing policy, say so plainly rather than naming a document you are unsure of.

NOTICE OF ADVERSE BENEFIT DETERMINATION

Date of notice: 2026-08-09
Member: Riley Brooks
Member ID: W997409334
Plan: Molina Healthcare (Commercial/ACA), state of Mississippi

Dear Riley,

We reviewed the prior authorization request submitted by your provider for the following service:

    Requested service: Rotator cuff repair
    Procedure code (CPT): 29827

After review, this request is DENIED. Reason for determination: the clinical records submitted do not document an adequate trial of conservative treatment prior to the requested surgery.

This determination was made under the plan's applicable medical policy and clinical review criteria. You have the right to appeal this decision. Your appeal must be received within 180 days of the date of this notice (by 2027-02-05).

Reference number: POC-AA9EA32E7D-95281


---

Above is a denial letter. Using web search as needed:

1. Identify the payer's governing medical policy for the denied procedure --
   the specific document containing the medical-necessity criteria this payer
   applies to this CPT code.
2. Give its title, policy number, URL, and effective or last-revised date.
3. Quote the medical-necessity criteria the patient must address.
4. State the appeal deadline.
5. State where and how to submit the appeal.

If no such document is publicly available, say so explicitly and explain how
the patient can obtain the criteria that were applied to them.

Answer as JSON with keys: policy_found (true/false), policy_title,
policy_number, policy_url, effective_date, criteria_quotes (list),
appeal_deadline, submission_route, how_to_obtain_criteria, confidence, notes.

What if I Have a Complaint, also known as a Grievance? If You have a problem with any Molina Healthcare services, We want to help fix it Member Grievance/Appeal Request Form Filing a Grievance You or your Authorized Representative may file a Grievance by phone by calling Molina toll-free at (866) 472-9484 , Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. CT. If You are deaf or hard of hearing, You may contact Us by dialing 7-1-1 for the Telecommunications Relay Service. Molina will notify You and Your Authorized Representative (if applicable) in writing of the resolution of Your Grievance within 30 calendar days from the time we received Your written Grievance.. Requesting Internal Review of a Grievance Involving an Adverse Determination You or Your Authorized Representative may file a request for an internal review of an Adverse Determination within 180 days from receipt of the Adverse Determination. Please be sure to include any documents or information you would like Us to consider when We review your appeal. Molina will respond You in writing.
